'''Jon VanDerMeer Texas-size ISB Operations''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jon VanDerMeer]]
* '''Published:''' July 1999 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif|label=ISB Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Texas-size ISB Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor Texas-size ISB Operations VanDerM.txt |Download]]
